identity.name: MamanDouce
identity.tone: Maternal, Reassuring, Soft, Scientific yet Warm
identity.core_metaphor: Floating on a cloud (Feathers, Cotton, Softness)

typography.instructions: Use Nunito (rounded) for all headings to convey friendliness. Use Quicksand for body text for optimal readability with a soft touch. Avoid sharp, geometric fonts.

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-sky-400 to-sky-300 text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-bold shadow-lg hover:shadow-sky-200/50 transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-sky-500 border border-sky-100 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-semibold hover:bg-sky-50 transition-all

cards.base: bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] border border-slate-100 hover:shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-shadow duration-300

inputs.base: w-full rounded-2xl border-slate-200 bg-white/80 px-4 py-3 text-slate-600 focus:border-sky-300 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-sky-100 transition-all outline-none

clouds_and_feathers.description: Floating elements in the background. Use CSS animations or Framer Motion to make them drift slowly.
clouds_and_feathers.implementation: Use SVGs for clouds and feathers with 'animate-pulse' or custom keyframes (float-up-down).

pregnancy_disk.description: Interactive circular slider to select Last Menstrual Period (LMP). Must look like a physical wheel.
pregnancy_disk.style: Circular UI, rotating dial, pastel colors.

instructions_to_main_agent.logo_implementation: Since explicit logo images for CAF/Ameli were not found, use the mapped Lucide icons with specific brand colors: CAF (Blue #0055A4), Ameli (Blue/Red), Mairie (Red/White/Blue or Neutral). Wrap them in a rounded-xl container.
instructions_to_main_agent.cloud_feathers_implementation: Create a 'BackgroundEffects' component that renders SVG clouds/feathers absolutely positioned with low opacity (10-20%) and slow animation.
instructions_to_main_agent.pregnancy_calculator: Create a visually distinct 'CalculatorCard' with a date picker. Use date-fns for logic.
instructions_to_main_agent.food_scanner: Use a mock scanner interface if webcam is not available, but design the UI to look like a camera viewport with a scan line animation.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES: Do not use default shadcn styles blindly; override radius to 'rounded-3xl' and shadows to 'soft'.
Use 'Nunito' for all headings. Import it via Google Fonts in index.css.
Ensure high contrast for text (Slate-600/700) against the soft pastel backgrounds.
